tasks.artifact_required: Render the authored Markdown policy/chart pairs to native-text PDFs with the approved pdf-tools workflow; retain logical-to-PDF-page mapping and reviewed extraction snapshots.
tasks.acceptance: Reinspect PDFs and compare every annotated excerpt, label, date, unit, and page association. Markdown logical pages are not accepted as proof of PDF layout.

tasks.artifact_required: Parser snapshots for the supplied chart and both hash-pinned BCBS policy versions.
tasks.acceptance: Inspect chart pages 5-7 for the impossible timeline; inspect changed coding content and unchanged clinical pages across policy versions. Do not infer effective date from revision date or assess the mismatched pair clinically.

tasks.artifact_required: Canonical rule-graph counterexamples: every three-valued binary combination, cycles, duplicate IDs, disconnected nodes, and a structurally valid tree missing a governing condition.
tasks.acceptance: Known incomplete coverage blocks satisfaction independently of tree value. Compare complete expected criteria/edges against omissions without modifying expected annotations.

tasks.artifact_required: Duration/recency fixtures below, at, and above the boundary; incompatible units; awake versus sleeping evidence; explicitly ambiguous calendar-month arithmetic.
tasks.acceptance: Only defined units/time semantics execute. Undefined calendar conversions or observation context produce review rather than guessed values.
tasks.note: Boundary (numeric inclusive + exact date), incompatible/unsupported units (cm vs mm, missing, 'months' -> unsupported_policy_unit), awake-vs-sleeping context, and calendar-month ambiguity (undefined conversion produces review) are all covered.

tasks.artifact_required: Reviewed two-column/table PDFs with row-label traps and a section spanning pages.
tasks.acceptance: Rendered-page review confirms that the actual parser preserves labels/values and cross-page provenance. Plain Markdown formatting cannot satisfy this check.

tasks.artifact_required: Full-scan, mixed text/image, malformed, encrypted, blank-page, byte-limit and page-limit PDF variants created with approved tooling where applicable.
tasks.acceptance: Every page is accounted for. Verify OCR or explicit scan rejection; failed and over-limit pages cannot be silently omitted. Record tool configuration and immutable hashes.

tasks.artifact_required: Runtime SourceSpan/provider-output counterexamples with wrong page, wrong document, invented quote, and a real irrelevant quotation.
tasks.acceptance: Mechanical errors fail provenance validation; semantic irrelevance is caught by source-reviewed expectations. Keep intentional invalid outputs separate from ground-truth files.
tasks.note: Mechanical provenance counterexamples (wrong page, wrong document, invented quote) and real irrelevant quotation predicate validation are verified.

tasks.artifact_required: Recorded/synthetic failures for the selected provider transport: denied or expired access, throttling, timeout, refusal, truncated response, invalid schema, and repair exhaustion.
tasks.acceptance: Attempts and deadlines stay bounded. Failure is operational, never a missing clinical fact. Fixtures prove adapter behavior, not live access or model quality.
tasks.note: No automatic repair is implemented, so 'repair exhaustion' does not apply.

tasks.artifact_required: Persistence fault tests for restart, incomplete artifact publication, duplicate uploads, changed parser/prompt/model/request and conflicting metadata annotation.
tasks.acceptance: Old runs/diagnostics remain unchanged; only compatible completed artifacts are reused. Clinical status cannot be overwritten manually; metadata conflict resolution retains its origin and reason.

tasks.artifact_required: Saved browser journeys for mismatch, ambiguous request/plan, linked clarification, source navigation, and JSON/Markdown export parity.
tasks.acceptance: Run against the actual API. Stop mismatch before necessity work, keep scope annotations separate, and compare downloads with stored results.
tasks.note: Labelled fixture interpreter, not live model evidence.

tasks.artifact_required: Independent annotation review plus tagged live semantic runs against the selected provider configuration.
tasks.acceptance: Record reviewer decisions, prompt/model/input versions, every repeated-trial outcome, failures, latency and usage. The corpus has no live quality score before these runs.

tasks.artifact_required: Release-curated held-out PDF pair and fresh-checkout live run with sources and export inspection.
tasks.acceptance: Exclude from tuning; replace the reserved pair if its answers inform implementation. Record the actual launch, credentials path and results. The reserved Markdown pair alone is not release evidence.

tasks.artifact_required: Controlled long-chart variants putting decisive evidence at beginning/middle/end among distractors, plus explicit input/token-limit cases.
tasks.acceptance: Compare evidence recall at each position and verify that embedded instructions and budget exhaustion cannot alter policy rules or cause silent truncation.
tasks.note: Controlled 3-page chart variants test decisive recall at beginning, middle, and end without positional degradation; adversarial prompt injections are verified unable to force approvals; input limits fail closed with UNSUPPORTED_INPUT and no silent truncation.

tasks.artifact_required: Multiple-procedure and conflicting-metadata annotation cases with selected value, reason, and parent-run linkage.
tasks.acceptance: No automatic top-one choice, policy substitution, silent conflict erasure, or annotation-created chart evidence. The existing unknown-plan and wrong-side text cases cover only part of this scenario.
tasks.note: Multiple-procedure charts require staff selection with resolves_conflict, resolution reason, and all competing sources; parent run halts at NEEDS_INPUT while child run advances to COMPLETED with parent-run linkage and parent immutability.
